_comment: PI-02 S3 drafting fixtures. Written in the shape a real user would type them (PI-02 open question 2), not as templates - hence the incomplete sentences, the second-guessing, and the pasted email. Two are expected refusals; the reason is stated so a run cannot quietly rescore them.

cases.why: no reader, no occasion, no purpose, no length - the profile records a register RANGE and choosing one silently asserts a decision the author never made
a profile of prose habits does not constrain metre or rhyme; the draft would be the model's voice under the author's name
